en: A monochrome historical postcard depicting an ornate multi‑storey palatial building on a city street. The façade features elaborate stonework, columns, balconies, and corner towers. People and a horse‑drawn carriage stand in front of the building. Printed captions at the top read the city and country and identify the building as the Kolmar Palace. Shop signs in the ground floor windows are also visible.
